description: Vélocité - vélos disponibles - Ville de Liège is a dataset listed in Spi open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données reprend les vélos indiqués comme "LIBRE" à la location dans les espaces PRO VELO sur le territoire de Liège dans le cadre de "Vélocité". Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par les services de la Ville de Liège sur le terrain. Coverage: Wallonia. The portal files it under Transports, Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, mobilité douce, vélo, location, MOBILITY IN LIEGE METROPOLE. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-spi-digitalwallonia-portal.
